summary: Equitable Holdings filed an 8-K reporting stockholder votes at a July 30, 2026 special meeting on the Agreement and Plan of Merger with Corebridge Financial. Equitable stockholders approved adopting the merger agreement and the non-binding advisory compensation proposal. The merger involves Corebridge's wholly-owned subsidiaries, Mountain Holding, Palisade Holding, and Marcy Holding, with Equitable as the target. Voting results showed 240,939,623 shares present (88.27% quorum). Exact terms, including price per share and premium, were not disclosed in the excerpt. The merger is part of Corebridge's acquisition of Equitable, with structural details pending. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions, typical risk-arb focus.
